first_option: Sick Leave Policy: Mental health concerns fall under the standard sick leave policy. A doctor's note is required for absences exceeding two consecutive days.
second_option: Mental Health Days: Employees may take up to 8 mental health days per year separate from PTO, with no documentation required and no manager approval needed.

first_option: Office Attendance Standard: Employees are expected to be in the office five days per week. Remote work is permitted only under documented exceptional circumstances.
second_option: Flexible Remote Work: Employees may work remotely up to three days per week, with the team and manager jointly setting the schedule based on the work that needs to be done.

first_option: Internal Transfer Program: Employees who have been in a role for at least one year may request a transfer to another department, with hiring managers required to interview them.
second_option: External Hiring Priority: Most open roles are posted externally first. Internal candidates may apply but receive no formal preference in the selection process.

first_option: Open Promotion Cycle: Any employee may nominate themselves for promotion during the annual cycle. Decisions are made by a cross-functional committee with documented criteria.
second_option: Manager-Initiated Promotion: Promotions are initiated by direct managers based on their assessment. Self-nomination is not part of the process.

first_option: Mentorship Matching: New hires are matched with a senior mentor within their first two weeks. Mentorship pairs meet biweekly and have a structured 12-month curriculum.
second_option: Self-Directed Onboarding: New hires complete a self-paced onboarding portal. Mentorship is available on request but not assigned.

first_option: Pay Transparency: All salary bands are published internally, and individual employees can request anonymized data on peer compensation within their level.
second_option: Confidential Compensation: Salary information is confidential and may not be discussed among employees. Pay bands are not published.
